candidates.title: Heavy rains, squally wind likely in West Bengal from September 22

candidates.title: Getting away from gunshots
candidates.excerpt: For many young Israelis, Dharamkot in Himachal Pradesh offers an escape from the pressures of military service and conflict, drawing them to India’s Hummus Trail, in search of peace and healing.
